svg.aria-label: flowstate/ — Python · EEG · Arduino R4. Real-time focus tracking from a forehead EEG sensor — a live 0–100 score that buzzes the moment you zone out. Physiological, not a webcam guessing at your gaze. Link: github.com/Crepco/flowstate.
